_doc: Farm animals (docs/hvf-PLAN.md §5) — the farmers' income and the hunters' main tell. Read by js/sim/modes/hvf/animals.js. income = gold per second each; wander = metres from home; speed m/s; breed = seconds per new animal (one at a time per building); sight m (they are team vision); noise radius m and period s (H3); hp. `rules`: wander every [min,max] s; crowding: comfort = open cells within the wander radius / comfortCells, over it the radius x crowdMult; flee from a hunter or army unit within fleeRange for fleeSeconds at fleeSpeed x; a stray is outside wander x strayMult; a ghost farmer's animals go wild (wander x wildMult, no income); caps per farmer and per match.
